title: Product Information RCN 2001/5001/8001 FS — Angle Encoders for Direct-Drive Axes
locator: Direct-drive position-control loop signal quality, motor-current noise and thermal consequence explanation
notes: Manufacturer's product information explains how encoder signal quality can disturb the position and current control loops, increase current noise and power dissipation, and contribute to axis thermal deformation. It is product/application guidance, not a universal quantitative threshold. PDF is linked only and not archived.
